page.overview:
Who is Ingrid?

https://blog.playstation.com/2025/06/06/capcom-announces-resident-evil-requiem-year-3-for-street-fighter-6-and-updates-to-onimusha-way-of-the-sword/ in Street Fighter 6 as part of the game's Year 3 Character Pass. Ingrid is an enigmatic and powerful being of cosmic origin with an important, yet mysterious destiny.

Ingrid was created by video game director Toyohisa Tanabe and designed by Senri Kita and Hidetoshi "Neo_G" Ishizawa for Capcom Fighting All-Stars. She was meant to debut alongside three other original characters, D.D., Rook, and Avel, all four of which are collectively known as the Code Holders. After the cancellation of All-Stars, Ishizawa, who had become a game designer for Capcom Fighting Evolution, sought to include original elements into the game and chose to revive Ingrid. She was recreated from the ground up as a 2D sprite using her 3D model and moveset from All-Stars as a basis. At the request of Ishizawa, Ingrid's sprite would later be ported to Street Fighter Alpha 3 MAX, introducing the character into the Street Fighter series.

Her existence as a divine being and her Nordic theming is evocative of Belldandy, from the long running fantastical slice of life anime Oh My Goddess!, from the mangaka and character artist for the Namco Tales JRPG series, Kosuke Fujibayashi.

Ingrid is an extremely powerful and mysterious entity who detests dark forces such as the evil nature of both the Satsui no Hado and Psycho Power. Wise and intelligent, despite her apparent physical age, she also has a playful and mischievous side which includes a snarky sense of humor. She has also been shown to toy with her opponents in humiliating ways such as punishing anyone defeated by her with tickling, poking, paddling or even doodling over faces.
